The FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2026) reports one remaining material weakness, and the auditor gave an adverse opinion on internal control.

- **Remaining weakness:** The auditor's report says one weakness still stands, tied to IT controls over user access to financial applications and systems. The company's information technology controls for certain systems that support some of the financial reporting processes did not operate for a sufficient period of time.
- **Three earlier weaknesses fixed:** Management says it cleared three weaknesses reported in the FY2025 10-K. Its FY2026 filing states that it remediated three material weaknesses previously reported, and the one remaining ITGC weakness remains unremediated as of June 30, 2026.
- **Auditor's opinion:** For each of fiscal 2024, fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 the auditor issued an unqualified opinion on the financial statements and an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting. The auditor's report says the weakness did not change its opinion on the financial statements themselves. The weakness was considered in planning the audit, and the report does not affect the audit report dated August 31, 2026 on those statements.
- **Auditor identity:** One third-party tracker lists BDO USA, P.C. as the auditor. The 10-K states the firm has served as the Company's auditor since 2024. I didn't confirm the firm's name from a primary source, so check the filing's audit report signature.
- **Remediation timing:** Management believes the actions taken will likely remediate the weakness, subject to completing operating-effectiveness testing during fiscal year 2027.

Links: [{"title":"Super Micro: What can we learn from the DOJ indictment?","url":"https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micro-what-can-we-learn-from"},{"title":"Super Micro’s Export Control Issues: Compliance and Financial Reporting Implications","url":"https://natlawreview.com/article/super-micros-export-control-issues-compliance-and-financial-reporting-implications"},{"title":"Supermicro CEO insists 'no one' beyond indicted employees were involved in alleged $2.5 billion smuggling scheme","url":"https://fortune.com/2026/05/05/supermicro-ceo-stock-smuggling-nvidia-amd-broadcom-intel/"},{"title":"Super Micro's export control issues: relationships with customers and financial reporting considerations","url":"https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-export-control-issues"},{"title":"Super Micro shares tank 33% after employees charged with smuggling Nvidia chips to China","url":"https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/19/us-tech-execs-smuggled-nvidia-chips-to-china-prosecutors-say.html"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Form 8-K - FY2026","url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536526000011/a991.htm"},{"title":"Three men charged with illegally smuggling advanced AI chips into China","url":"https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/three-men-charged-illegally-smuggling-advanced-ai-chips-china-rcna264371"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Super Micro Computer Issues Statement on Action by U.S. Attorney's Office","url":"https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2026/Super-Micro-Computer-Issues-Statement-on-Action-by-U-S--Attorneys-Office/default.aspx"},{"title":"Super Micro $2.5B Chip Smuggling Case [Updated April 2026]","url":"https://tech-insider.org/super-micro-nvidia-chip-smuggling-china-2026/"},{"title":"supermicro arrested founder smuggling gpu china","url":"https://fortune.com/2026/03/19/supermicro-arrested-founder-smuggling-gpu-china/"}]

The March 2026 indictment in the Southern District of New York charged three people tied to Supermicro, but not the company itself.

- **The charges:** In an indictment unsealed Thursday, the U.S. government alleged that Yih-Shyan "Wally" Liaw, Ruei-Tsan "Steven" Chang and Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun worked together to violate the Export Control Reform Act. Liaw co-founded the company and sits on its board. Liaw and Sun were arrested that day, while Chang remains a fugitive.
- **The alleged scheme:** A Southeast Asian company acting as middleman allegedly compiled fake paperwork and had a logistics firm repackage the servers to conceal them before they went to China. The indictment said servers sold for $510 million between late April 2025 and mid-May 2025 went to the Southeast Asian company and on to China. CNBC also reported that the efforts have yielded around $2.5 billion in sales for the server maker since 2024. Treat the $2.5 billion figure as a sales total, not a confirmed smuggling amount; Fortune's headline frames it as smuggling.
- **Company position:** Supermicro says it has been cooperating fully with the government's investigation. The company says it is not a defendant or a target of a grand jury investigation. On April 7 it announced a board-led independent investigation into the allegations. That review is led by two independent board members and supported by the law firm Munger, Tolles & Olson LLP and forensic accounting consultants from AlixPartners.
- **Scrutiny:** On the company's earnings call, the CEO said that, based on what is known so far, no one other than those named in the indictment was involved, though that could change. A senior vice president and board member has since been fired. Liaw has pleaded not guilty and is free on a $5 million bond.
- **Conflicting report:** One source (tech-insider.org) says prosecutors charged two former logistics managers in April. Other sources I found don't corroborate this, so I'd verify it against court records before relying on it.

I ran one search and did not check the DOJ press release or court docket directly. Any developments after April or May 2026 may not be captured here.

The investigation results don't address fiscal 2026 revenue, receivables, or inventory. The search only turned up coverage of the investigation's conclusions about misconduct and financial reporting.

- **Scope and conclusions:** The probe concerned the March 2026 indictment of three former associates. It found no evidence that current senior management knew about the alleged diversion scheme, and no evidence that the company sold export-controlled products directly to restricted parties. The announcement is dated August 20, 2026.
- **Financial statements:** One report says the investigators found no evidence that the diversion affected the credibility of previously issued financial reports (The investigation found no evidence that any potential diversion of restricted products affects the credibility of Supermicro's previously issued financial reports). Another summary says the probe found no impact on financial statements. These are secondary summaries, not the full findings.
- **Who ran it:** Lead Independent Director Scott Angel and Audit Committee Chair Tally Liu led the probe. Munger, Tolles & Olson conducted it, and AlixPartners served as forensic accounting consultant (Munger, Tolles & Olson LLP conducting the investigation and AlixPartners serving as independent forensic accounting consultant).
- **Company's position:** Supermicro says it was not named as a defendant in the indictment and is not accused of any wrongdoing.
- **Gaps:** None of the results include the company's fiscal 2026 revenue, receivables, or inventory figures, or any auditor commentary on them. The primary press release and the company's SEC filings (10-K) would be the places to check those numbers.

content.text:
**風險評分：58 / 100（中高）**

這是相對風險分數，不是重編財報的機率。我估計 FY2026 財報日後真的被重編或修正的機率大約 10–15%，仍明顯高於一般大型上市公司（通常每年 1–3%）。以下判斷依據公開報導與 10-K 的摘要資訊，我沒有逐頁讀完 10-K 原文。

## 拉高風險的因素

1. **內控連續三年被出具否定意見。** FY2024、FY2025、FY2026 會計師對財務報表都給無保留意見，但對內部控制都給否定意見。FY2026 仍有一項重大缺失沒改善：財務系統的使用者存取權限，以及部分 IT 一般控制的執行期間不夠長。存取控制失效的影響會擴及所有依賴系統的自動化控制和報表，所以這項缺失看起來只有一項，實際涵蓋面很廣。
2. **財報問題有前科，而且反覆出現。**
   - 2018–2019 年因營收認列問題延遲申報並重編財報，2020 年與 SEC 以 1,750 萬美元和解。
   - 2024 年 Hindenburg 發布放空報告後，安永（EY）在 2024 年 10 月辭任，並公開表示不願再依賴管理層與審計委員會的聲明。之後公司延遲申報，再改聘 BDO。
   - 同類問題一再發生，代表管理層的誠信態度（tone at the top）有疑慮。
3. **出口管制案（2026 年 3 月起訴）。** 共同創辦人兼董事 Wally Liaw 等三人被控把伺服器轉運到中國：2025 年 4–5 月約 5.1 億美元，報導稱自 2024 年以來相關銷售累計約 25 億美元。對財報可能有三方面影響：
   - **營收認列：** 客戶身分或交易實質如果有問題，交易是否成立、帳款能否收回都會受質疑。
   - **或有負債（ASC 450）：** 美國商務部 BIS 罰款、司法部後續行動、證券集體訴訟的負債估計和揭露，可能不夠充分。
   - **信用風險：** 中間商相關的應收帳款可能需要提列減損。
4. **營運與會計判斷壓力。** 營運資金吃緊，存貨與應收帳款都很高，AI 伺服器毛利率持續下滑。存貨跌價、價格折讓、退貨準備都需要大量主觀判斷。另外與 Ablecom、Compuware 等關係人交易的歷史疑慮仍在。
5. **Liaw 本人的紀錄。** 他 2018 年因會計問題離職，後來又回任，並涉入本次案件。這讓人質疑公司治理是否真的改善。

## 壓低風險的因素

1. **財務報表本身獲無保留意見。** 會計師明確表示，內控缺失不影響它對財務報表的意見。
2. **重大缺失從四項降到一項。** 剩下的 IT 一般控制缺失預計在 FY2027 完成有效性測試。
3. **獨立調查已結束（2026 年 8 月 20 日）。** 調查由 Munger, Tolles & Olson 主導，AlixPartners 擔任鑑識會計顧問。結論是現任高層不知情，也沒有證據顯示既有財報的可信度受影響。這是我看到的二手報導摘要，不是調查報告全文。
4. **外部監督很強。** 新任會計師 BDO、SEC、檢方與放空機構都在盯，嚴重錯誤被發現的機率相對高，也間接抑制管理層操縱的空間。

## 為什麼是 58 分

- 內控否定意見、前科和出口管制案三項疊加，原本足以給 70 分以上。
- 財報獲無保留意見、獨立調查結論正面、重大缺失已大幅減少，所以下修到中高區間。
- 最大的不確定性在出口管制案：BIS 和司法部的後續處分，以及集體訴訟的或有負債。如果之後又有其他員工或客戶被起訴，或 SEC 開始調查營收認列，分數應上調到 70–80。如果 FY2027 第一季的 10-Q 確認最後一項重大缺失已改善，可下調到 40–45。

## 建議優先查核的 10-K 項目

- 會計師報告裡的關鍵查核事項（CAM）
- 或有事項附註（訴訟、出口管制）
- 關係人交易附註
- 存貨跌價準備與應收帳款備抵的變動
- 前十大客戶集中度與地區營收變化，特別是東南亞

   - **或有負債（ASC 450）：** 美國商務部 BIS 罰款、司法部後續行動、證券集體訴訟的負債估計和揭露，可能不夠充分。
   - **信用風險：** 中間商相關的應收帳款可能需要提列減損。
4. **營運與會計判斷壓力。** 營運資金吃緊，存貨與應收帳款都很高，AI 伺服器毛利率持續下滑。存貨跌價、價格折讓、退貨準備都需要大量主觀判斷。另外與 Ablecom、Compuware 等關係人交易的歷史疑慮仍在。
5. **Liaw 本人的紀錄。** 他 2018 年因會計問題離職，後來又回任，並涉入本次案件。這讓人質疑公司治理是否真的改善。

## 壓低風險的因素

1. **財務報表本身獲無保留意見。** 會計師明確表示，內控缺失不影響它對財務報表的意見。
2. **重大缺失從四項降到一項。** 剩下的 IT 一般控制缺失預計在 FY2027 完成有效性測試。
3. **獨立調查已結束（2026 年 8 月 20 日）。** 調查由 Munger, Tolles & Olson 主導，AlixPartners 擔任鑑識會計顧問。結論是現任高層不知情，也沒有證據顯示既有財報的可信度受影響。這是我看到的二手報導摘要，不是調查報告全文。
4. **外部監督很強。** 新任會計師 BDO、SEC、檢方與放空機構都在盯，嚴重錯誤被發現的機率相對高，也間接抑制管理層操縱的空間。

## 為什麼是 58 分

- 內控否定意見、前科和出口管制案三項疊加，原本足以給 70 分以上。
- 財報獲無保留意見、獨立調查結論正面、重大缺失已大幅減少，所以下修到中高區間。
- 最大的不確定性在出口管制案：BIS 和司法部的後續處分，以及集體訴訟的或有負債。如果之後又有其他員工或客戶被起訴，或 SEC 開始調查營收認列，分數應上調到 70–80。如果 FY2027 第一季的 10-Q 確認最後一項重大缺失已改善，可下調到 40–45。

## 建議優先查核的 10-K 項目

- 會計師報告裡的關鍵查核事項（CAM）
- 或有事項附註（訴訟、出口管制）
- 關係人交易附註
- 存貨跌價準備與應收帳款備抵的變動
- 前十大客戶集中度與地區營收變化，特別是東南亞
